responsibility: Implements RTL dead store elimination using a combination of local cselib-based scanning, global backward dataflow for selected address classes, and a post-register-allocation spill-slot-oriented treatment. The file owns the multi-step DSE pipeline: collecting read/store records, deciding whether global analysis is worthwhile, building and solving store-kill equations, deleting dead stores and same-value redundant stores, handling alias analysis and exception-edge cleanup, and exposing the two RTL pass instances "dse1" and "dse2".
